map.发明 20 年、实用新型 10 年、外观设计 15 年（2021-06-01 起: Invention 20 years, utility model 10 years, design 15 years (for applications filed on or after 2021-06-01), all counted from the filing date.
map.列出未来年费缴纳节点与滞纳期提醒。: Lists future annual fee payment dates and grace period reminders.

map.专利有效期从授权日算吗？: Does the patent term run from the grant date?
map.不是，自申请日起算；授权日只影响「授权后」的保护，期限长度以申请日为起点。: No, it runs from the filing date; the grant date only affects protection after grant, while the term length starts at the filing date.
map.年费忘交会失效吗？: Does forgetting to pay the annual fee invalidate the patent?
map.会在应缴期满日起终止，但有 6 个月滞纳期（加收滞纳金）；期满未缴则专利权终止，: It terminates when the fee due date passes, but there is a 6-month grace period with a late payment surcharge; if unpaid the patent right terminates, and restoration is possible but under strict conditions.
